mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 600K units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when HOUST > 600K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal improving labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between UNRATE and labor market participation rates
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 30% of instances with consecutive UNRATE declines, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising GDP (GDPC1) and increasing retail sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns with joint GDPC1/RSAFS growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals reduced supply chain pressures, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between INDPRO and supply chain indices
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of instances when INDPRO < 6-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increasing consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals tightening monetary conditions, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns with joint FEDFUNDS/CPIAUCSL growth are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A single-month spike in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 200K signals a labor market shock, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical impact of labor market shocks on SPX
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 200K, or Rank IC < 0.005 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a declining GDP growth rate (GDPC1) and decreasing housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.005 over any 2-year rolling window during late-cycle expansions, or 60-day forward returns with joint GDPC1/HOUST declines are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) in those regimes.
